responsibility: This file implements debugging and dump support for gfortran’s internal parse tree, symbols, namespaces, and interoperable declarations. It traverses gfc_code, gfc_expr, gfc_symbol, type, array, and global-symbol structures to print human-readable representations for dumps and debugger helpers, and also emits C prototypes and typedefs for BIND(C) entities or external procedures when the corresponding compiler options request interop declarations.
